title: Sync reconnect manager crashes when the WebSocket global is undefined
reason: Reports reconnect/disconnect handlers dereferencing static WebSocket constants where the global constructor is undefined, producing errors in production. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This concerns the upstream sync reconnect manager; Varve has no corresponding sync WebSocket client.

title: Dragging shapes crashes when a moving shape is deleted mid-drag
reason: The reply confirms #10171 skips shapes or drop targets deleted during translation instead of passing undefined into translate hooks. The trigger depends on remote collaboration deleting a selected shape mid-drag.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no live concurrent collaborators; no equivalent mid-drag external deletion was reproduced.

title: Laser tool crashes when its scribble session times out mid-stroke
reason: Describes a race between a fading laser scribble timeout and a delayed pointer/tick event that tries to continue a completed session. The report gives background-tab and throttled-browser triggers but no comments.

varveAssessment.assessment: Searched Varve tool sources for a laser tool/session; no matching transient laser interaction exists.

title: Paste throws an unhandled rejection when the clipboard changes during read
reason: Reports an InvalidStateError from ClipboardItem.getType when clipboard contents change between listing MIME types and reading a type, escaping the paste flow as an unhandled promise rejection. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: `packages/editor/src/clipboard.ts` catches per-type getType failures and catches navigator.clipboard.read failures, preserving other MIME fallbacks; the reported rejection path is guarded in the inspected implementation.

title: Pasting tldraw content with unknown shape types crashes the editor
reason: Reports tldraw clipboard content carrying a shape type with no registered shape util, causing placement calculations to throw. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve clipboard parsing rejects unknown node kinds before state mutation (`parseClipboardNode` returns null and `parseClipboardData` rejects the fragment). Varve's clipboard schema has no tldraw shape-util dispatch.

title: Pasting content from a newer tldraw version crashes instead of showing an error
reason: Reports newer tldraw clipboard content failing migration with an uncaught error instead of an actionable paste error, affecting both hosted and desktop app versions. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's versioned clipboard parser accepts only declared historical/current format versions and returns null for unknown versions before paste; this inspection found no equivalent unchecked migration throw in the clipboard entrance.

title: Pasting Excalidraw drawings with custom stroke widths fails validation
reason: Reports an upstream Excalidraw converter mapping arbitrary strokeWidth to a four-value enum, producing undefined for unsupported widths. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Searched Varve editor import paths for an Excalidraw importer; none is present. Varve stores stroke weight as a numeric value rather than the upstream four-size enum.

title: Content with non-canonical fractional index keys crashes paste and file open
reason: Reports third-party-generated tldraw files/clipboard data with invalid fractional index keys failing schema validation during paste/import/open. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses a separate scene-array ordering model and versioned Varve document validators; it does not import tldraw fractional-index record keys. The `order` key is auxiliary metadata, not the authoritative node position.

title: Sync connect fails with Invalid string length on very large room snapshots
reason: Reports a large-room full snapshot exceeding JavaScript string serialization limits in the hosted sync connect response, causing repeated reconnects for the affected desktop user. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not serialize a shared room snapshot over a sync connect response; no equivalent service limit applies.

title: Chunked sync messages are mis-assembled after a socket is replaced or the Durable Object wakes mid-message
reason: The sole comment says related malformed-chunk errors continued in the current release from Sep 24 to Oct 7, so the issue remains reported despite existing handling. This is the server's per-session chunk assembler across socket replacement and Durable Object sleep/wake.

varveAssessment.assessment: The protocol/server path is upstream sync infrastructure not implemented by Varve.
